name: realtime-delivery-platform
description: Plataforma Full Stack de delivery com pedidos em tempo real.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix back-end && npm ci --prefix front-end
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix back-end && npm run lint --prefix front-end
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix back-end && npm run typecheck --prefix front-end
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix back-end && npm run test --prefix front-end
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix back-end && npm run test:coverage --prefix front-end
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix back-end && npm run build --prefix front-end
scripts.audit: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix back-end audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix front-end audit --audit-level=high
